description: Canonical set of shell control operators that separate one command from the next. Every consumer that decomposes a Bash command into pieces splits on exactly this set, so a command breaks into the same pieces for every gate that examines it.
output: The command split into pieces at each unquoted occurrence of a listed operator; a two-character operator (&&, ||) always binds before its single-character form (&, |).
invariants: SET-EQUAL across all consumers: the shell gate's sed splitter, the Go classifier, and the Go cwd resolver each split on this exact set; no consumer may add or drop an operator alone.
A redirect operator that begins with & (&>, &>>) or contains | (>|) is delimited by the redirect predicate, not split here, so its & or | is never mistaken for a lone connector.
Deterministically sorted by Unicode code point for byte-stable diffs.
